name: Custom Select
summary: A custom select is a button that opens a listbox you styled yourself. Use it when a native <select> cannot carry what a row has to show — an icon, a second line, a color swatch. It needs JavaScript, and the trigger has to announce the current value, not only its label.
demoNote: Open any of these and type the first letters of an option to jump to it. The panel anchors to its trigger at every width, and flips above it when there is no room below.

contract.useWhen: A custom select, for when the native one cannot be styled the way you need. Needs JavaScript.
keyboard: close, then tab on from the trigger
open it, or choose the focused option
jump to the first option starting with it
failureModes: aria-activedescendant rather than real DOM focus, unreliable on iOS VoiceOver and TalkBack
the trigger named by its label alone, so the current value is never announced
a hidden <select> behind it, so one value lives in two places and they drift
a disabled option left with a tabindex, so the keyboard lands on something inert
a div as the trigger, so aria-expanded sits on something with no role
api: AC.createDropdown(root) -> { open, close, isOpen, value, setValue, refresh, element, destroy }
